# Options with which the ready-made parsers of the alpha-parsers repository are generated from the grammars in this
# directory: <name> <zp gen options>. The size report of bench/report generates the parsers with them.
cel -types -typed-only -nodoc -runtime import
csv -types -recognize -budget-controls -nodoc -runtime import
cue -types -typed-only -nodoc -runtime import
duckdb -types -typed-only -nodoc -runtime import
golang -expectations -types -typed-only -nodoc -runtime import
json -types -recognize -budget-controls -nodoc -runtime import
python -expectations -types -typed-only -nodoc -runtime import
typescript -expectations -types -typed-only -nodoc -runtime import
xml -expectations -types -recognize -budget-controls -nodoc -runtime import
yaml -types -recognize -budget-controls -nodoc -runtime import
